display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-05-D4-07 Integrating circularity in LCA-based modelling frameworks for renovation of buildings (Built4People Partnership) – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-05-D4-07 Integrating circularity in LCA-based modelling frameworks for renovation of buildings (Built4People Partnership)
executive_summary: Horizon Europe Innovation Action under the Built4People partnership (People-centric sustainable built environment) that funds a modelling framework integrating circularity assessment into building life cycle assessment (cradle to cradle), applied to at least three real-life building renovations in different climatic regions and countries, assessing embodied and operational emissions under EN 15978, up to TRL 6-8. Open to consortia under the standard Horizon Europe rules. Lump-sum grant at the Innovation Action rates (70% for for-profit entities, up to 100% for non-profit). Indicative topic budget EUR 27 million, around EUR 6.75 million per project, about four projects. Planned opening 5 May 2027; single-stage deadline 15 September 2027.
status_rationale: Horizon Europe Work Programme 2026–2027 Part 8 (Climate, Energy and Mobility), pp. 203–205, Specific conditions, Expected Outcome and Scope of HORIZON-CL5-2027-05-D4-07, funds life cycle assessment frameworks that integrate circularity strategies for the renovation of buildings towards net-zero whole-life carbon. It does not touch TenneT's field: the scope is restricted to buildings, their materials and their operational energy use, with no link to grid infrastructure or system operation, and no project file is close to it. No project date is set because the call states no start, end or duration.
